review_basis: Final actual experiments and independent agent recalculation; qualitative coursework requirements are distinct from biological confirmation.

2.conclusion: Known-structure rediscovery and the complete candidate workflow are supported; three unannotated shape-outlier candidates are replicated under the original default rule. All candidates now have full-background, scale, common-depth, coverage-counterfactual and fixed-classifier checks. A2 has strong coverage-confounding evidence. A common new type is not established.

5.conclusion: The final full-window neural model is chosen only on validation after train-only adaptation. Both repetitions support PSNR/SSIM improvement and recovery of the main non-near-diagonal CHIN/OPCID shapes and profiles over complete intervals; all 68 full structures per repetition are retained, with CHID supplementary results and matched learned interpolation controls. Fine near-diagonal OPCID details are not fully recovered and peak localization is not universally improved.

6.conclusion: All three declared final models preserve their rep2 contact advantage over MDS. In the complete published circular region definition, all seeds have positive overall four-domain distance organization and higher overall AUC than MDS. Published three-locus ordering is reproduced. Individual-domain and boundary-version differences and non-significant adjusted cyclic-shift tests remain explicit.
